items.source: Creates a new ConverterBuilder.WritingConverterBuilder to produce a converter to write values of the given source (the domain type) into the given target (the store type).
items.translation: 创建一个新ConverterBuilder.WritingConverterBuilder，用于生成一个转换器，将给定源类型（即领域类型）的值转换为给定目标类型（即存储类型）。

items.source: General purpose conversion framework to read objects from a data store abstraction and write it back.
items.translation: 通用转换框架，用于从数据存储抽象中读取对象并将其写回。
ConverterBuilder.WritingConverterBuilder 在 org.springframework.data.convert 中的用途
